The '''Tower of Magilou''' is a mage tower in [[Northwind]]. It was formerly inhabited by [[Enchantress Magilou]], but after an incident with her apprentice [[Thronda]] her own assembly of arcane elementals to help with her chores, they've grown out of control and now terrorize the tower, forcing Magilou and Thronda to find refuge in a nearby home.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|30|Magilou's Magical Mishap}}</ref>

[[Legacy of Stormwind's Court Magicians|A monument to Stormwind's Court Magicians]] is erected across from the tower.
